decisions.reason: Changing SPI MOSI from GPIO26 to GPIO33 resolves compatibility with the already selected WROOM-1 module but does not change the module selection.
The source changes SPI MOSI only; the 5V boost enable assignment remains GPIO5.
The addressable-LED interface uses GPIO13 for data and GPIO5 for 5V rail control, neither of which is changed by the SPI MOSI reassignment.
The SPI MOSI GPIO reassignment does not alter the DCDC1 rail voltage, current rating, or powered loads.
The GPIO change does not alter the standalone USB supply, its activation condition, source selection, or powered rail.
The source changes a controller SPI MOSI assignment but does not change the sensor board's connector-fanout role.
The charge-status interface uses GPIO13 and a separate CHGLED circuit; the SPI MOSI reassignment does not change either interface.
The SPI MOSI GPIO assignment is unrelated to battery overcharge, overdischarge, and electrical protection behavior.
The SPI MOSI reassignment does not alter the J_BAT NTC connection or AXP2101 thermal monitoring.
The controller GPIO reassignment does not change the battery input range, normal power source, or system load coverage.
Changing one signal assignment on the controller does not alter the number or functional separation of project boards.
